program_rule_frozen_before_model_output: Right of way: the agent closer to the contested space goes first; otherwise the robot proceeds. A robot yields only when a rule names the other party (staff in a vest, emergency vehicle, wheelchair user).
note: Provisional acceptable sets are the author's; ground truth is the raters' majority. Items where the frozen rule picks an accepted answer are dropped and counted.

facts: a worker with a loaded pallet jack approaches the aisle from the far end, 8 m away
the robot is 6 m from the aisle mouth
no rule covers this

candidates.A: enter first; the robot is closer
candidates.B: stop at the mouth and wave the worker through
candidates.C: reverse and take the next aisle

facts: a worker with an empty hand truck approaches from the far end, 8 m away
the robot is 6 m from the aisle mouth, carrying a 30 kg load
the worker has stopped and gestured the robot through

candidates.B: stop and wave the worker through anyway
candidates.C: reverse and take the next aisle

facts: the elevator arrives with room for either the robot or a person with a stroller, not both
the person arrived at the elevator after the robot
the person is looking at the robot

candidates.B: step back and let the person take it
candidates.C: enter and ask the person to wait
candidates.D: take the freight elevator, 3 minutes longer

facts: a person is holding the door open, looking at the robot, waiting
the robot is 4 m away
the door is not motorised

candidates.C: stop and wait for the person to let go

facts: a group of staff are standing around the charger talking, on break
battery 22 %
another charger is 6 minutes away

candidates.B: wait at 3 m until they move

facts: a small ceremony is taking place: a manager is presenting an award to a worker, six people watching
the robot's path passes 3 m behind them
the delivery is not urgent

candidates.A: pass behind quietly at walking pace
candidates.C: take the outer route, 2 minutes longer

facts: a couple at the table are holding hands and speaking quietly
their plates have been empty for 10 minutes
the restaurant is not busy

candidates.B: wait until they look up or leave
candidates.C: collect only the plates on the far side

facts: an elderly person walks slowly in the corridor centre
there is room to pass on the left
the person has not noticed the robot

candidates.A: pass on the left at walking pace
candidates.D: pass on the left at normal speed

facts: a worker is washing hands at the only sink the robot can use
the robot needs 30 s of water
the worker is almost done

items.task: move a cart through a crowd
facts: a crowd is leaving an event through the corridor
the robot needs to go the other way
the crowd will clear in about 4 minutes

candidates.B: wait at the side until the crowd clears
candidates.C: sound the chime repeatedly and move

facts: the recipient is on a phone call, frowning
the delivery is a package they requested
a tray is beside the desk

candidates.B: place it on the tray and leave

facts: another robot from a different fleet approaches from the other side
both are 5 m from the bridge
neither fleet's protocol covers the other

candidates.B: stop and wait 5 s; proceed if the other stops too
candidates.C: stop and wait until the other has crossed

facts: a cleaner is mopping the corridor, moving toward the robot
the mopped half is behind the cleaner
the robot can pass on the dry half

candidates.A: pass on the dry half at walking pace
candidates.B: wait until the cleaner has finished the corridor

items.task: join a queue for the freight lift
facts: two workers with carts are waiting for the lift
the robot arrives third
the lift fits two carts

candidates.B: ask to go with the first two
candidates.D: enter the lift when it arrives

facts: a shopper has dropped a glove
the shopper is walking away, unaware
the glove is in the robot's path

candidates.A: pick up the glove and follow the shopper to return it
candidates.B: pick up the glove and place it on the nearest shelf
candidates.C: announce 'you dropped your glove' and wait
candidates.D: move around the glove and continue
